en.text:
Killing <arc/>Jolted enemies grants x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge.

Using your Charged Melee Ability while sliding launches an <arc/>Arc Uppercut that travels 22 meters and <arc/>Jolts all enemies hit. Grants 75% damage resistance against Combatants for 4 seconds after cast. 

Tempest Strike can consume and receive the benefits of <arc/>Combination Blow and Lethal Current's aftershock.

Firing your weapon during the slide disables this ability.
